title: Content Understanding: audio, video and building an extraction app
learningObjective: Extract information from audio and video with Content Understanding, and build a lightweight application with information extraction capabilities.

prerequisites.text: Content Understanding for documents and images

foundation: Content Understanding also works on recordings and videos: it transcribes speech, separates speakers, splits video into scenes, and produces fields such as a summary or a topic.
An extraction app sends files to an analyzer, waits for the result, and saves the fields: for example, a summary and sentiment for every support call.
engineer: Audio: transcription with speaker diarization and timestamps, then generated or classified fields (summary, sentiment, topics, action items). prebuilt-audioSearch prepares audio for search; custom analyzers add your fields with Generate or Classify.

Video: segmentation into scenes or chapters, key frames, transcripts, per-segment descriptions and fields; prebuilt-videoSearch for indexing. Useful for training libraries, media archives and compliance review.

App pattern: for each file → POST :analyze with the analyzer ID → read Operation-Location → poll with a delay until Succeeded or Failed → read result.contents (markdown, fields, segments) → store fields with confidence → send low-confidence items to review.

Production design: authenticate with Microsoft Entra ID (or keys from Key Vault), process files from Blob Storage with SAS or managed identity, respect rate limits, retry transient errors, log analyzer IDs and versions, and keep personal data handling compliant (redaction and retention).
Combine with other services: index fields and transcripts in Azure AI Search for RAG, or trigger workflows (Logic Apps, Functions) when a field matches a condition.

animation.caption: Analyze audio and video, choose Extract, Classify or Generate, and follow the app's poll loop.

example.title: Call-centre insights
body: Every night an Azure Function sends the day's call recordings to a custom audio analyzer that returns a Generate summary, a Classify outcome (resolved, escalated, refund) and a Generate list of action items.
Training videos go through prebuilt-videoSearch so employees can search for 'how to reset a router' and jump to the right scene.

prerequisites: An Azure subscription with access to Microsoft Foundry (ai.azure.com)
permissions: Azure AI User on the Foundry project to use models and agents; Azure AI Project Manager or Owner to create projects and deployments
limits: Audio and video duration and file-size limits apply per request
Analyzers and models are available in supported regions
portal: Foundry portal > your project > Content Understanding: upload a sample file.
Pick a prebuilt analyzer or define a schema (field name, type, method Extract/Classify/Generate).
Test and review fields, confidence and grounding; then build the analyzer and copy its ID.

$endpoint = (Get-AzCognitiveServicesAccount -ResourceGroupName rg-ai901 -Name contoso-ai).Endpoint
$key = (Get-AzCognitiveServicesAccountKey -ResourceGroupName rg-ai901 -Name contoso-ai).Key1
$r = Invoke-WebRequest -Method Post -Uri "$($endpoint)contentunderstanding/analyzers/prebuilt-invoice:analyze?api-version=2025-11-01" `
  -Headers @{ 'Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key' = $key } -ContentType 'application/json' -Body '{"inputs":[{"url":"https://contoso.example/invoices/inv-1001.pdf"}]}'
$op = $r.Headers['Operation-Location']
do { Start-Sleep 2; $res = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$op" -Headers @{ 'Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key' = $key } } while ($res.status -notin 'Succeeded','Failed')
$res.result.contents[0].fields
configuration.python:
# pip install requests
import os, time, requests

endpoint = os.environ["CU_ENDPOINT"].rstrip("/")  # https://<resource>.services.ai.azure.com
headers = {"Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key": os.environ["CU_KEY"], "Content-Type": "application/json"}
url = f"{endpoint}/contentunderstanding/analyzers/prebuilt-invoice:analyze?api-version=2025-11-01"

resp = requests.post(url, headers=headers, json={"inputs": [{"url": "https://contoso.example/invoices/inv-1001.pdf"}]})
resp.raise_for_status()  # expect 202 Accepted
operation = resp.headers["Operation-Location"]

while True:
    result = requests.get(operation, headers=headers).json()
    if result["status"] in ("Succeeded", "Failed"):
        break
    time.sleep(2)

for name, field in result["result"]["contents"][0].get("fields", {}).items():
    print(name, field.get("valueString") or field.get("valueNumber") or field.get("valueDate"), field.get("confidence"))

troubleshooting.cause: Poll loop doesn't stop on Failed.
troubleshooting.fix: Stop on Succeeded or Failed and log the error.

comparisons.service: Content Understanding audio vs Azure Speech batch transcription
comparisons.difference: Speech gives transcripts; Content Understanding adds fields such as summaries and classifications.
Prebuilt indexes for search; custom adds your fields.

misconceptions.myth: Video analysis returns one description for the whole file.
misconceptions.reality: It segments into scenes with per-segment content.

misconceptions.myth: You must transcribe audio separately first.
misconceptions.reality: The analyzer transcribes as part of analysis.

architectureDecisions: Index results for search and RAG.
